payload.prompt: Whose video series opens with these words?
payload.quote: Forge my own journey from scratch.
payload.explanation: Settled's Swampletics, an Ultimate Ironman who never left Morytania.

payload.prompt: Adam, the Ironman tutor in Lumbridge, had his hair dyed purple after which creator did the same for charity?
payload.explanation: B0aty, known for their Ironman videos. Adam is a nod to them.

payload.prompt: The tick-perfect way to keep hitting Vorkath while dodging his dragonfire is named after which player?
payload.explanation: The Woox Walk, named after the player who devised it.

payload.prompt: In Deadman Mansions, who captained TeamLUL?
payload.explanation: Faux. B0aty captained TeamCBS, and Torvesta and Sick Nerd played under Faux.

payload.prompt: Who was the guest on the seventh episode of the Official OSRS Podcast?
payload.explanation: Solo Mission, in 2025. B0aty followed in episode 8.

payload.prompt: How many days after the Inferno came out did Woox claim the first Infernal cape?
payload.explanation: Two. The Inferno opened on 1 June 2017, and Woox was the first player to get the cape.

payload.prompt: Which of these creators played for TeamLUL in Deadman Mansions?
payload.explanation: Raikesy, Alfie and Torvesta, with Sick Nerd, under Faux. B0aty captained Framed and Soup on TeamCBS, and TeamLUL won by a point.

payload.prompt: Whose Hardcore Ironman series coined this catchphrase?
payload.explanation: C Engineer, whose monotone "Completed" voice line also became a popular RuneLite plugin.

payload.prompt: Which YouTuber is famous for opening his videos with this greeting?
payload.explanation: Dovydas, better known as A Friend, who opened with "Hello, it's me, A Friend" and ended with a sudden "Bye."

payload.prompt: Whose classic RuneScape machinima videos made a meme of headbanging while shouting a god's name?
payload.explanation: TehNoobShow, in the classic Gods Exposed machinima series.

payload.prompt: Which PvP creator's videos frequently open with him whispering from a bush or disguise?
payload.explanation: Torvesta, known for his high-risk Wilderness PKing and undercover skull-trick videos.

payload.prompt: Whose restricted Ironman series begins with this rule?
payload.explanation: Settled's Tileman series, where every movement tile had to be bought with experience all the way to the Infernal cape.

payload.prompt: Paul, the Ultimate Ironman tutor in Lumbridge, is named after which streamer who pioneered unofficial Ironman play?
payload.explanation: Faux (Paul), whose self-restricted Ironman streams helped inspire Jagex's official Ironman modes.

payload.prompt: Which player designed Rooftop Agility and waves at you from the end of the Seers' Village and Ardougne courses?
payload.explanation: BigRedJapan pitched Rooftop Agility in a 2013 player-designed content competition and appears as an NPC on the courses.

payload.prompt: A broken-down tractor in Hosidius is an in-game tribute to which community member whose map designs inspired the Great Kourend rework?
payload.explanation: GentleTractor, whose player-made redesign map of Zeah shaped Jagex's overhaul of Great Kourend.

payload.prompt: How did Woox famously survive the final fog in the October 2016 Deadman Invitational before being disqualified?
options: Buying stews in the Warriors' Guild
payload.explanation: Woox stood in Rimmington unnoting food with Phials to out-eat the fog damage.

payload.prompt: Which Fossil Island demi-boss famously ended A Friend's high-ranking Hardcore Ironman, "White Cat22"?
payload.explanation: Deranged Archaeologist, whose special attack hit White Cat22 twice in a row shortly after Fossil Island's release in 2017.

payload.prompt: Which creator hosts Gielinor Games, the survivor-style competition series pitting OSRS creators against each other?
payload.explanation: Soup, who created and hosts Gielinor Games and is also fondly teased for his chaotic quest guides.

payload.prompt: Which creator is behind By Release, a series completing every quest in chronological order of its original release date?
payload.explanation: J1mmy, who played through every quest in release order starting from 2001's Cook's Assistant.

payload.prompt: Which YouTuber became famous for real-time quest guides that always open with "Hi, and welcome to my guide"?
payload.explanation: Slayermusiq1, whose step-by-step quest guides carried players before the RuneLite Quest Helper plugin existed.

payload.prompt: What hitsplat did Skill Specs land on B0aty with an Armadyl godsword in 2015, turning the number into an OSRS meme?
payload.explanation: 73. Right after B0aty laughed that Skill Specs couldn't kill him, Skill Specs landed a 73 AGS spec to KO him.

payload.prompt: What was the combat level of the lowest-level account on which Rendi obtained a Fire cape in Old School RuneScape?
payload.explanation: Combat level 3, achieved by Rendi in 2020 using rings of recoil and tick-eating before Jagex patched the mechanics.

payload.prompt: Which of these are the names of the three Ironman tutors outside Lumbridge Castle?
payload.explanation: Adam (after B0aty, for Ironman), Paul (after Faux, for Ultimate Ironman) and Juan (a pun on "one" life, for Hardcore Ironman).

payload.prompt: How many US dollars did Mod Ash offer to pay Woox out of his own pocket after Woox was disqualified from the October 2016 Deadman Invitational?
payload.explanation: $10,000, matching the tournament's first-place prize, after Woox survived the fog by unnoting food at Phials.

payload.prompt: How many episodes did Settled's Swampletics series run for, from the first episode to the Theatre of Blood finale?
payload.explanation: 33 episodes between 2018 and 2022, ending with Swampletics completing the Theatre of Blood.

payload.prompt: In his famous Reddit AMA while grinding to become the first player with 200 million XP in every skill, what did Lynx Titan say he ate every day?
options: Bread three times and lasagne once
Two bowls of oatmeal and a pizza
payload.explanation: Bread three times a day and lasagne once a day for nearly four years.

payload.prompt: Which creator popularized the Xtreme Onechunk Ironman ruleset, grinding 99 Defence and 99 Woodcutting before leaving the starting Lumbridge chunk?
payload.explanation: Limpwurt, whose extreme chunk-locked rules require completing every highest-level task and boss drop in a map chunk before rolling the next.

payload.prompt: Which creator spent thousands of hours maxing an Ultimate Ironman locked entirely to Karamja?
payload.explanation: Verf, whose Karamja-only Ultimate Ironman started at level 3 and eventually maxed and completed the Inferno.

payload.prompt: Which satirical Wilderness PKer uses a robotic text-to-speech voice to deliver lines like this while sending players back to Lumbridge?
payload.quote: Smoked quicker than a Virginia Slim on a cold Sunday morning.
payload.explanation: 25 Buttholes, known for his deadpan text-to-speech PKing videos and catchphrase "wow, hahaha."

payload.prompt: Which YouTuber is best known for investigating and exposing bizarre bot farms across Gielinor?
payload.explanation: SirPugger, whose videos track down hidden bot farms, gold farmers and exploits.
